items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: Limon Dauphin, Wooden Joe. Uh, my trammone player

ctx.x: With the, uh, uh, Limon Dauphin. Limon.
Uh, you know him? I know who he is. You told me about him once before. Oh yeah. Where did you play? What place? Where from? Yeah, in the city.
Yeah, well... Well, he'll come to you in a little while.
Yeah, it's been... I got him. Limon Dauphin. Limon Dauphin. Dauphin, yeah.
Oh. Creole brother. I never heard of him before. No. Who else was there? Albert Litty was in the band?
